Flat Roofing

Flat Roofing across Sevenoaks, Kent and South London - a recent example: In Sevenoaks, an old flat roof was replaced with a three-layer torch-on felt system over three days.

How We Do Flat Roofing

We specialise in flat roof repairs and replacements using high-quality torch-on felt, GRP fibreglass and EPDM rubber roofing systems. We inspect the existing roof structure, replace damaged decking where necessary, and install a durable, fully weatherproof roofing system. Particular attention is given to drainage, joints, upstands and lead flashings.

Recent Flat Roofing Work

A Recent Job

In Sevenoaks, an old flat roof was replaced with a three-layer torch-on felt system over three days.

What Others Get Wrong

"A lot of firms are inexperienced applying GRP roofs and don't know how to work with the material. We also see a lot of burnt roofs from too much heat and not enough compression, which leaves weak seams on the overlaps."

Signs You Need Flat Roofing

  • Water pooling on the roof that doesn't drain away
  • Bubbles or blisters in the covering
  • The felt cracking, curling or lifting at the edges
  • Water coming through the ceiling below

How Long It Takes and What It Costs

A flat roof can take anywhere from one day to a week to complete, depending on the size.

Flat roofs typically start from around £1,000.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you repair a flat roof, or does it need replacing?

It depends on the condition of the covering. If it's old and letting water in, replacement is usually the better option - we fit torch-on felt, GRP fibreglass and EPDM rubber systems.

What is the best material for a new flat roof?

We fit torch-on felt, GRP fibreglass and EPDM rubber, and we'll recommend the right one for your roof rather than pushing one material for every job.
